newsitem.title: GERMANY: DMG Research ups Volkswagen EPS outlook.
newsitem.headline: DMG Research ups Volkswagen EPS outlook.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Research, the research wing of Germany's Deutsche Bank, said on Friday that it had raised its EPS outlook for carmaker Volkswagen AG and was maintaining its "overweight" recommendation on the stock.
Gunther Dielmann, analyst at DMG Research, said the group had raised its 1996 EPS to 55 marks from 33 marks, to 65 marks from 43 marks for 1997 and to 86 marks from 65 marks.
"The recommendation for the stock remains overweight," Dielmann told Reuters. He said that there was room for "clearly positive development" in the share price.
Volkswagen was up 110 marks, or 11.04 percent, at 1,106 marks in bourse trade on Friday.
Volkswagen on Thursday kicked off 1997 by forecasting better first quarter earnings due to a 9.5 percent rise in sales, adding it expected higher profits and sales for the year.
An analysts' meeting later in the day was warmly received and many auto analysts raised their outlooks for the carmaker.
